test: L0-REL-31: discriminate H-status vs H-window vs H-strict-with-exceptions on the same-day decision-cell edits
status: FROZEN BEFORE any diff hunk or edit-commit subject is read
edits: every commit where the row's column-3 cell differs (whitespace-normalized) from its previous version (from the frozen register_history_check.py parsing)

mechanical_indicators_per_edit (computed.status_marker: PREPARED if the row contains 'PREPARED' and no 'ADOPTED <date>' / 'THIS RULING IS GOVERNING'; ADOPTED-OR-GOVERNING if it contains either; NONE otherwise (an unmarked row = issued by the human authority, governing at issue per F-LOG-0124 P3')
mechanical_indicators_per_edit (computed.cited_by_other_rows: number of OTHER rows in the pre-edit version whose text contains the ruling ID as a whole token

bounded_read: the word-level diff of column 3 (old vs new) for each edit, and the edit commit's subject line; nothing else
edit_kind (coded from the hunk): LABELLED-CORRECTION (the change itself says it corrects/amends)
SUBSTANTIVE (a claim added, removed or changed)

predictions.H-status: every SUBSTANTIVE or REWORDING edit has pre-edit status_marker = PREPARED
predictions.H-window: every SUBSTANTIVE or REWORDING edit has cited_by_other_rows = 0
predictions.H-strict-with-exceptions: at least one SUBSTANTIVE edit with status_marker != PREPARED and cited_by_other_rows > 0 and no LABELLED-CORRECTION

decision_rule: a hypothesis is FALSIFIED by one counter-instance among these edits; both H-status and H-window may survive; STRUCTURAL edits are excluded from all three
